{{Current events|year=2025|month=05|day=8|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are reportedly killed when a [[Piper PA-31T Cheyenne]] [[air ambulance]] crashes between [[Tiltil]] and [[Curacaví]] in [[Chile]]. [https://www.elmorrocotudo.cl/noticia/sociedad/revelo-una-identidad-alcalde-de-arica-da-por-fallecidos-ocupantes-de-avion-desapare (''El Morrocotudo'')]
*Five tourists and a pilot are killed, and one other person is injured, when a [[Bell 407]] aircraft crashes and falls into a deep [[gorge]] near [[Bhagirathi River]] in [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/uttarakhand/helicopter-crash-uttarakhand-uttarkashi-rescue-operation-underway-updates/article69551988.ece (''The Hindu'')] [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/4-tourists-killed-as-helicopter-crashes-near-uttarakhands-uttarkashi-8359505 (NDTV)]
*123 [[vulture]]s are killed, more than 80 others are rescued, and an [[elephant]] is also poisoned in a mass [[poisoning]] at [[Kruger National Park]] in [[South Africa]]. [[South African National Parks]] and the [[Endangered Wildlife Trust]] says it was one of the largest vulture poisoning events in the country. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/climate-and-environment/article/vultures-rescued-from-mass-poisoning-in-south-african-game-reserve/ (CTV News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Abundant Life Christian School shooting]]
**The father of Natalie Rupnow, the perpetrator of the [[Abundant Life Christian School shooting|shooting]] that killed three people, including herself, and injured six others at the [[Abundant Life Christian School]] in [[Madison, Wisconsin|Madison]], [[Wisconsin]], [[United States]], in December 2024, is charged with felonies in connection with the shooting. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/father-of-15-year-old-who-killed-2-at-wisconsin-religious-school-faces-felony-charges/ (CTV News)]
*[[Killing of Cassius Turvey]]
**Jack Steven James Brearley and Brodie Lee Palmer are found guilty for the murder of [[Aboriginal Australian]] schoolboy Cassius Turvey in [[Middle Swan, Western Australia|Middle Swan]], [[Western Australia]], in 2022. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce9vzzxpdm7o (BBC)]
*A member of the [[MS-13]] gang is sentenced to 55 years imprisonment for the [[mass stabbing]] murders of five people, including a teenager and three young men at a park in [[Long Island]], [[New York (state)|New York]], United States, in April 2017. [https://patch.com/new-york/brentwood-central-islip/gang-member-sentenced-role-slaughtering-4-youths-doj (Patch.com)]


'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 papal conclave]]
**[[Catholic cardinal|Cardinal]] Robert Francis Prevost of the United States is elected to the [[pope|papacy]] on the fourth ballot and takes the name [[Pope Leo XIV|Leo XIV]]. He is the first pope from the United States and North America, and the second from the Americas after his predecessor, [[Pope Francis]]. A dual citizen of the United States and [[Peru]], he follows Francis to also become the second [[South America]]n pope. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/new-pope-conclave-day-two-05-08-25 (CNN)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/may/08/new-pope-conclave-vatican-white-black-smoke-papacy-catholic-cardinals (''The Guardian'')]
